
## Setup

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(emmeans)
library(modelsummary)
df_params <- read_csv(
  "/Users/sm6511/Desktop/Prediction-Accomodation-Exp/data/Combined/df_params_by_explanation_for_R-Study2.csv"
) |>
  mutate(
    explanation_group = factor(
      explanation_group,
      levels = c(
        "predictor",
        "non_explainer",
        "causal_explainer"
      ),
      labels = c(
      "Predict",
      "Accommodate\n(No Causal Explanation)",
      "Accommodate\n(Causal Explanation)"
      )
    ),
    model_param_score = factor(
      model_param_score,
      levels = 0:3
    )
  )
```
```{r}
contingency_all <- table(
  df_params$explanation_group,
  df_params$model_param_score
)

contingency_all

chi_test <- chisq.test(contingency_all)

chi_test

# Observed counts
chi_test$observed

# Expected counts
chi_test$expected
plot_df <- df_params |>
  count(
    explanation_group,
    model_param_score,
    name = "n"
  ) |>
  group_by(explanation_group) |>
  mutate(
    proportion = n / sum(n)
  ) |>
  ungroup()
```
```{r}
ggplot(
  plot_df,
  aes(
    y = explanation_group,
    x = proportion,
    fill = model_param_score
  )
) +
  geom_col(
    position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE)
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      label = paste0("", n)
    ),
    position = position_stack(
      vjust = 0.5,
      reverse = TRUE
    ),
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1),
    labels = scales::percent
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Proportion",
    y = NULL,
    fill = "Complexity score"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14)
```





```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lme4)
library(emmeans)
library(lmerTest)
library(ordinal)
library(performance)
library(modelsummary)

df_long4 <- read_csv(
  "/Users/sm6511/Desktop/Prediction-Accomodation-Exp/data/Combined/df_long_by_explanation_for_R-Study2.csv"
) |>
  mutate(
    feature_relevance = relevel(
      factor(feature_relevance),
      ref = "irrelevant"
    ),

    feature_dimension = factor(
      feature_dimension,
      levels = c("color", "tail", "wing"),
      labels = c("Color", "Tail", "Wing")
    ),

    # Feature-specific explanation grouping
    feature_explanation_group = case_when(
      task == "predict" ~ "Predict",

      task == "accommodate" &
        had_causal_explanation_for_feature == TRUE ~
        "Accommodate\n(Causal Explanation)",

      task == "accommodate" &
        (
          had_causal_explanation_for_feature == FALSE |
          is.na(had_causal_explanation_for_feature)
        ) ~
        "Accommodate\n(No Causal Explanation)",

      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    feature_explanation_group = factor(
      feature_explanation_group,
      levels = c(
        "Predict",
        "Accommodate\n(No Causal Explanation)",
        "Accommodate\n(Causal Explanation)"
      )
    )
  )

df_wing <- read_csv(
  "/Users/sm6511/Desktop/Prediction-Accomodation-Exp/data/Combined/df_wing_byexplanation_for_R-Study2.csv"
) |>
  mutate(
    feature_explanation_group = case_when(
      task == "predict" ~ "Predict",

      task == "accommodate" &
        had_causal_explanation_for_feature == TRUE ~
        "Accommodate\n(Causal Explanation)",

      task == "accommodate" &
        (
          had_causal_explanation_for_feature == FALSE |
          is.na(had_causal_explanation_for_feature)
        ) ~
        "Accommodate\n(No Causal Explanation)",

      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    feature_explanation_group = factor(
      feature_explanation_group,
      levels = c(
        "Predict",
        "Accommodate\n(No Causal Explanation)",
        "Accommodate\n(Causal Explanation)"
      )
    ),

    wing_relevant = relevel(
      factor(wing_relevant),
      ref = "1"
    ),

    wing_high = relevel(
      factor(wing_high),
      ref = "1"
    )
  )

```

```{r}
contrasts(df_wing$feature_explanation_group) <- contr.sum(3)
contrasts(df_wing$wing_relevant) <- contr.sum(2)
contrasts(df_wing$wing_high) <- contr.sum(2)

model_wing <- lm(
  feature_importance ~ feature_explanation_group * wing_relevant * wing_high,
  data = df_wing
)

summary(model_wing)
```
```{r}
joint_tests(model_wing)
```

```{r}
contrasts(df_long4$feature_explanation_group) <- contr.sum(3)
contrasts(df_long4$feature_relevance) <- contr.sum(2)
contrasts(df_long4$feature_dimension) <- contr.sum(3)

model_eff <- lmer(
  feature_importance ~
    feature_explanation_group *
    feature_relevance *
    feature_dimension +
    (1 | participant),
  data = df_long4
)

summary(model_eff)
joint_tests(model_eff)
```
```{r}

joint_tests(model_eff)
emm_task <- emmeans(model_eff, ~ feature_explanation_group)
pairs(emm_task, adjust = "tukey")
```

```{r}
emm <- emmeans(model_eff, ~ feature_dimension * task)
contrast(emm, interaction = c("pairwise", "pairwise"), by = NULL)
```


```{r}
# 1. Collapsed across feature relevance

plot_summary <- df_long4 |>
  filter(
    !is.na(feature_explanation_group),
    !is.na(feature_dimension),
    !is.na(feature_importance)
  ) |>
  group_by(
    feature_dimension,
    feature_explanation_group
  ) |>
  summarise(
    mean_importance = mean(feature_importance, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_importance = sd(feature_importance, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n_distinct(participant),
    se_importance = sd_importance / sqrt(n),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(
  plot_summary,
  aes(
    x = feature_dimension,
    y = mean_importance,
    fill = feature_explanation_group
  )
) +
  geom_col(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    width = 0.7,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = mean_importance - se_importance,
      ymax = mean_importance + se_importance
    ),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    width = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      y = -0.5,
      label = n
    ),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    size = 2.5,
    vjust = 1
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(-1, 7.5)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Feature",
    y = "Mean feature importance",
    fill = "Condition"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lme4)
library(emmeans)
library(lmerTest)

df_corr2 <- read_csv(
  "/Users/sm6511/Desktop/Prediction-Accomodation-Exp/data/Combined/df_corr_by_explanation_for_R-Study2.csv"
) |>
  mutate(
    task = factor(
      feature_explanation_group,
      levels = c(
        "explainer",
        "non_explainer",
        "predictor"
      ),
      labels = c(
        "Accommodate\n(Causal Explanation)",
        "Accommodate\n(No Causal Explanation)",
        "Predict"
      )
    ),

    feature_relevance = relevel(
      factor(feature_relevance),
      ref = "irrelevant"
    ),

    feature_dimension = relevel(
      factor(feature_dimension),
      ref = "color"
    )
  )

contrasts(df_corr2$task) <- contr.sum(3)
contrasts(df_corr2$feature_relevance) <- contr.sum(2)
contrasts(df_corr2$feature_dimension) <- contr.sum(3)

model_corr <- lmer(
  correlation ~ task * feature_relevance *
    feature_dimension +
    (1 | participant),
  data = df_corr2
)

summary(model_corr)

joint_tests(model_corr)

emm_task <- emmeans(model_corr, ~ task)
pairs(emm_task, adjust = "tukey")

emm <- emmeans(
  model_corr,
  ~ feature_dimension * task
)

contrast(
  emm,
  interaction = c("pairwise", "pairwise"),
  by = NULL
)
```
```{r}
joint_tests(model_corr)
```

###ERROR

```{r}
df_merged <- read_csv('/Users/sm6511/Desktop/Prediction-Accomodation-Exp/data/Combined/df_merged_for_R-Study2.csv') |>
  mutate(
    task = relevel(factor(task), ref = "predict"),

    color_relevance = ifelse(irrelevant_dim == "color", "irrelevant", "relevant"),
    tail_relevance  = ifelse(irrelevant_dim == "tail",  "irrelevant", "relevant"),
    wing_relevance  = ifelse(irrelevant_dim == "wing",  "irrelevant", "relevant"),

    color_match_high = ifelse(color == color_high, 1, 0),
    tail_match_high  = ifelse(tail  == tail_high,  1, 0),
    wing_match_high  = ifelse(wing  == wing_high,  1, 0)
  )
```

```{r}
df_cue <- df_merged |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(color_match_high, tail_match_high, wing_match_high),
    names_to = "feature_dimension",
    values_to = "match_high"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    feature_dimension = str_remove(feature_dimension, "_match_high"),
    feature_relevance = case_when(
      feature_dimension == "color" ~ color_relevance,
      feature_dimension == "tail"  ~ tail_relevance,
      feature_dimension == "wing"  ~ wing_relevance
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(
    task, participant,
    relevant_dim_1, relevant_dim_2, irrelevant_dim,causal_color, causal_tail, causal_wing,
    feature_dimension, feature_relevance
  ) |>
  summarise(
    pred = mean(testing_responses[match_high == 1], na.rm = TRUE) -
           mean(testing_responses[match_high == 0], na.rm = TRUE),

    true = mean(food_amount[match_high == 1], na.rm = TRUE) -
           mean(food_amount[match_high == 0], na.rm = TRUE),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
  feature_explanation_group = case_when(
    task == "predict" ~ "predictor",

    task == "accommodate" &
      feature_dimension == "color" &
      causal_color ~ "explainer",

    task == "accommodate" &
      feature_dimension == "tail" &
      causal_tail ~ "explainer",

    task == "accommodate" &
      feature_dimension == "wing" &
      causal_wing ~ "explainer",

    task == "accommodate" ~ "non_explainer"
  ),

  feature_explanation_group = factor(
    feature_explanation_group,
    levels = c("explainer", "non_explainer", "predictor"),
    labels = c("Explainer", "Non-explainer", "Predictor")
  )
)|>
  
  mutate(
    signed_error = pred - true,
    abs_error = abs(pred - true),

    task = relevel(factor(task), ref = "predict"),
    feature_dimension = relevel(factor(feature_dimension), ref = "tail"),
    feature_relevance = relevel(factor(feature_relevance), ref = "irrelevant")
  )
```

```{r}
error_plot_summary <-
```
